top_signals.title: Dangote’s $16 Billion Refinery Faces Fresh Kenya Legal Challenge
top_signals.summary: A Kenyan consumer-rights group filed a petition challenging billionaire Aliko Dangote’s oil refinery planned for the port city of Lamu, the second such legal hurdle for the $16 billion project.

top_signals.title: Gunvor Renames Itself Centalion in Shift Under New Ownership
top_signals.summary: Commodities trading giant Gunvor Group is renaming itself Centalion Group Ltd. and plans to redomicile its corporate headquarters to Singapore, marking a shift for its new ownership after a management buyout last year.

top_signals.title: South Africa Delays Power-Grid Expansion Plan by Six Months
top_signals.summary: South Africa delayed by six months a request for proposals from private companies to build transmission lines, further slowing the expansion of the country’s electricity infrastructure.
